title: Learning Without Adversarial Training: A Physics-Informed Neural Network for Secure Power System State Estimation under False Data Injection Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2604.22784v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Power System State Estimation (PSSE) converts geographically distributed measurements into the voltage magnitudes and phase angles needed for grid monitoring and control. Learned estimators can perform this mapping rapidly, but model-aware False Data Injection Attacks (FDIAs) may corrupt their inputs while retaining AC plausibility and residual-based stealth. Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) limit candidate states through power-flow consistency; however, their robustness depends on balancing supervised and physics losses whose scales and gradient contributions evolve during training. This paper proposes a PINN that jointly learns homoscedastic uncertainty parameters and uses them to adapt the two objectives. The formulation assigns trainable log-uncertainties to the active-power, reactive-power, voltage, and angle losses while safeguarding against an underweighted physics objective. translated_title: 无需对抗训练的学习：一种面向虚假数据注入攻击下安全电力系统状态估计的物理信息神经网络
translated_abstract: 电力系统状态估计（PSSE）将地理上分布的测量数据转换为电网监控和控制所需的电压幅值与相角。学习型估计器可以快速完成这一映射，但具备模型感知能力的虚假数据注入攻击（FDIA）可能在保持交流合理性并规避基于残差检测的情况下破坏其输入。物理信息神经网络（PINN）通过潮流一致性来限制候选状态；然而，其鲁棒性依赖于监督损失与物理损失之间的平衡，而这些损失的尺度和梯度贡献在训练过程中会不断演变。本文提出一种联合学习同方差不确定性参数的PINN，并利用这些参数对两个目标进行自适应调整。该方案为有功功率、无功功率、电压和相角损失分配可训练的对数不确定性参数，同时防止物理目标被低估。该估计器仅在干净的稳态数据上训练……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种能联合学习同方差不确定性参数从而自适应平衡监督损失与物理损失的物理信息神经网络，在无需对抗训练的情况下实现了对虚假数据注入攻击具有鲁棒防御能力的电力系统状态估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a PINN that jointly learns homoscedastic uncertainty parameters to adaptively balance supervised and physics losses, achieving robust power system state estimation against false data injection attacks without adversarial training.
